categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet covers descriptor management; this PR adds descriptor creation logic in src/script/descriptor.{h,cpp} for multisig setup flows
categories.rationale: Adds helper logic to safely construct ranged multipath multisig descriptors without string interpolation errors. The PR addresses setup risks where callers had to manually assemble descriptors without validation, paving the way for multisig wizard tooling (#35645, #36325), but is not yet wired to end-user wallet flows directly.
